_about: The numbers a run is compared with (docs/build-and-test-reference.md). Changes only with the maintainer's approval. Runs are headless, --rtc-seed 1, --max-seconds 600 (or the entry's max_seconds), on the final config. Counts only. The *_vmu runs and the replay run attach a new memory card (a file that doesn't exist yet, so the program makes a blank, formatted one, as a player's first run does); the others attach none. linux_sandbox_speed_x is null where no Linux sandbox has made the run yet. discovery.bytes_total is the span of the emitted functions, not the boot image (3,075,648 bytes): the coverage pass measures against the image.

built_from: dream-recomp 3023c320a264, this repo's pin, built with scripts/10_build_linux.sh on 7 Nov 2026: on top of d990818, the host's floating-point mode for the runtime's own hooks and the run's end (56a4277, known bug 37; no guest arithmetic changes, the gate identical) and the boot's floating-point mode (3023c32, known bug 36: FPSCR 0x00040000, round to nearest, as the disc's bootstrap hands over, where it was 0x00040001). Bug 36's fix changes the game's arithmetic: the four 10-minute runs keep every count but interrupts and non-zero sound samples, and the recorded play-through no longer replays its recording (runs.tutorial_mission1_replay.stale_since). The translator is b222a6a's: discovery gives 12,184 functions, 756,050 instructions, 216 switch tables and 1,263,576 of 1,495,698 bytes, as at every pin since. The pin 6c098df gave 12,259 / 712,697 / 120 / 1,216,786 / 1,447,388.
